project: God of War — PS2 Static Recompilation
approach: Static recompilation of MIPS R5900 code to C++20, with a PS2Recomp-based runtime and God of War-specific overrides.
help: A Windows build with the native runtime
notes: Linux-first fork of KIexster/god-of-war-recomp. Playable on Linux: menus, gameplay, audio, movies with sound, save and load, about 55-59 fps average at 1080p render scale. Released as a builder AppImage that builds the runtime from your own ISO. Full playthrough not yet verified.
